seo.descripcion:
The podium of the most commented videos in the world this week.

Full countdown, from 10 to 1: https://youtu.be/xeD0jU5UnjU

Data from the official YouTube API. Synthetic voice narration. #Top10RS #shorts

escenas.texto: Which was the most commented video in the world this week? Here is the podium. Watch until the end.
In third place, Grand Theft Auto VI: Pre-Load Now, by Rockstar Games, with over 21 thousand comments.
In second place, Aku Masih Di Sini PART 11 - Dhot Design, by Dhot Design, with over 73 thousand comments.
And number one: COMPRÉ A MINI MINI.ULTRA EN LA DEEP WEB, by Fede Vigevani, with over 89 thousand comments.
The full countdown, from ten to one, is already on the channel. Find it in the description. Hashtag Top 10 RS.
